title: Top-cited AI scientists at four US companies (Top 2% List 2026)
excerpt: The typical top-cited AI scientist at Anthropic received 4,830 citations in 2025. At OpenAI it was 2,150, at Google 1,481 and at Meta 1,295.
content_html:
